target.title: fix(android): connect to protocol v3 gateways
target.body:
Closes #106185

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Android users could not connect to a Gateway running protocol v3 during a staggered app/Gateway upgrade because Android advertised only protocol v4.

## Why This Change Was Made

Android now generates a v3-v4 compatibility range from the existing N-1 protocol constant while Swift and generic clients remain v4-only. The native drift guard models those client-specific ranges, and Android replay coverage proves both v3 message-only and v4 incremental chat deltas converge to the same streamed reply.

## User Impact

Android can connect to Gateway protocol v3 or v4. Connections to current v4 Gateways and v4 chat streaming remain unchanged; protocol versions below v3 stay unsupported.

## Evidence

- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxda1h9knadsb7ea3basx4bj` / [run 29236154001](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29236154001):
  - `pnpm protocol:gen:kotlin` regenerated byte-identical Kotlin artifacts.
  - `pnpm test packages/gateway-protocol/src/native-protocol-levels.guard.test.ts` — 5 tests passed.
  - `./gradlew :app:ktlintFormat` — successful; touched Kotlin hashes unchanged.
  - `./gradlew :app:testThirdPartyDebugUnitTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.chat.ChatControllerStreamReplayTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.gateway.GatewaySessionInvokeTest` — passed.
  - `./gradlew :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.chat.ChatControllerStreamReplayTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.gateway.GatewaySessionInvokeTest` — passed.
- Source-blind behavior contract: regenerated range was exactly `3-4`; exact v3/v4 stream and connect-range filters passed.
- Autoreview command: `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --stream-engine-output`. No accepted findings; one false export-barrel finding rejected after explicit re-export inspection and successful generator runs.
